bulk_rss_corroboration.wait4_note: External wait4 peak includes waited descendants on Linux. Runtime provenance calls rustc --version after measured phase; isolated control rustc peak85,192,704 bytes versus true9,568,256 and cargo11,628,544. Therefore external wait4~85.2MB is compiler provenance peak, not client-self. Preserve it, but compare observer coverage against runtime internal RUSAGE_SELF peak~63.7MB.
bulk_rss_corroboration.method: External smaps_rollup reads following exe confirmation with1ms sleeps; actual intervals approximately1.15–1.18ms. Covers client runtime lifetime including measured phase and teardown. Original10ms phase sampler unchanged. Additional10 pairs have observer overhead offCPU3, original5 do not; all15 metrics preserve cohorts. vmhwm_verification.single_positive_delta_explanation: A22 lifetime VmHWM63,815,680 versus phase-end RUSAGE_SELF63,696,896 bytes (+0.18648%); lifetime observer includes minor later allocation. Allother19 match exactly.

bulk_hwm_corroboration.method: External observer on CPU 2 confirms /proc/PID/exe equals frozen runtime, then polls smaps_rollup Rss and status VmHWM with 1 ms sleeps; actual median intervals around 1.17–1.21 ms. VmHWM retains the client maximum and includes runtime initialization, measured phase and teardown. Runtime internal RUSAGE_SELF peak is read after measured phase. All 20 client VmHWM values match within 0.2%; 19 match exactly. Original five, first 10 smaps-only and final 10 high-water cohorts remain separate. All 25 aggregates cover unchanged CPU/allocation/throughput/self-peak metrics; observer overhead is present only in the last 20 pairs.
bulk_hwm_corroboration.authoritative_peak: Client RUSAGE_SELF peak corroborated by direct client VmHWM. Instantaneous 10 ms/1 ms RSS samples undercount transient peaks, are retained as coarse estimates, and their original increases are explicitly not declared passing. Parent wait4 includes rustc provenance descendant; preserved and excluded from client guardrail.
